panels.title: Trend scoreboard
panels.subtitle: Latest value, sparkline, and QoQ / YoY. A decline is favorable for reports and days of supply.
panels.source_note: Derived from the series on this page. Pending values stay pending.

panels.title: Revenue & earnings forecast
panels.subtitle: Seasonal-naive baseline only. Not an in-house model. No consensus feed.
panels.source_note: Actuals reuse SEC XBRL and approved company metrics when those series exist. The baseline copies the same quarter a year earlier. Bands and consensus are not estimated.

panels.title: Robotaxi fleet & markets
panels.subtitle: Fleet and active metros. The map uses disclosed places only.
panels.source_note: A reported fleet figure stays on its own series. A news-derived estimate is drawn separately, with its source link and confidence, and stays pending review.

panels.title: Cybercab production vs fleet
panels.subtitle: Units built against Cybercabs in the fleet and the total fleet.
panels.source_note: News-derived production figures are estimates, shown separately from any reported count, and stay pending review.

panels.title: Robotaxi utilization
panels.subtitle: Paid miles and miles per vehicle. Missing quarters stay blank.
panels.source_note: Paid miles are often chart-only. Tiles say not reported when the number was not disclosed.

panels.title: NHTSA SGO crash reports
panels.subtitle: Monthly counts by structured kind of issue. Reports are not fault findings.
panels.source_note: NHTSA Standing General Order 2021-01 ADS and Level 2 CSVs. Filtered by the catalog reporting entity. Narratives are redacted, so kind comes from Crash With, contact area, and pre-crash movement. Latest report version only.

panels.title: Energy production
panels.subtitle: Megafactory output against deployed storage.
panels.source_note: Deployed GWh reuses the company energy-storage metric when it has been collected. Per-site output is rarely disclosed.

panels.title: Storage deployments
panels.subtitle: Quarterly GWh. Country bubbles appear only for sourced manual entries.
panels.source_note: Reported deployed GWh stays on its own series. Megapack, Powerwall, and country figures from news are estimates, labeled and pending review, and are not a complete census.

panels.title: Semi contracts
panels.subtitle: Cumulative fleet customers.
panels.source_note: News-derived contract figures are estimates with a source link and confidence. They stay pending review and are not auto-approved.

panels.title: Semi orders
panels.subtitle: Cumulative units on order.
panels.source_note: News-derived order figures are estimates, shown separately from any reported count. A missing quarter is not zero.

panels.title: Semi production
panels.subtitle: Quarterly production when a number is actually disclosed.
panels.source_note: A reported production count stays on its own series. A news-derived estimate is separate, pending review, and is not treated as a disclosure.

panels.title: Semi milestones
panels.subtitle: Named milestones. A date appears only after a sourced manual entry.
panels.source_note: Milestone dates are manual and pending until a reviewer approves them.

panels.title: Chargers
panels.subtitle: Site totals from company metrics. Individual sites are not mapped yet.
panels.source_note: Station and connector totals reuse the quarterly operational summary when collected. Site coordinates need an NREL AFDC key or a licence review of supercharge.info / OpenChargeMap. No key is configured, so the map stays empty.

panels.title: FSD by region
panels.subtitle: Regional small multiples, with a small map for orientation. Not a choropleth.
panels.source_note: Total subscriptions reuse the company FSD metric when collected. The regional split is not disclosed. Launch dates can be entered manually and stay pending review.

panels.title: Production & deliveries
panels.subtitle: Model 3/Y, other models, and total deliveries.
panels.source_note: Quarterly production and deliveries release, already collected as company metrics when the filing is parsed.

panels.title: Inventory & days of supply
panels.subtitle: Build versus deliveries, and days of supply when disclosed.
panels.source_note: The build-versus-draw gap is production minus deliveries for quarters where both exist. Days of supply stays empty until disclosed.

panels.title: Optimus
panels.subtitle: Counts when disclosed. Otherwise the milestone list is the signal.
panels.source_note: Milestone dates taken from news are estimates. They stay pending review and are not auto-approved.

panels.title: New factories
panels.subtitle: One row per site. Dates appear only from sourced entries.
panels.source_note: Installed capacity can come from the deck's capacity table once that metric is collected. Construction milestones are manual.

panels.title: Energy projects pipeline
panels.subtitle: GWh by stage, only when a curator has sourced it.
panels.source_note: Pipeline GWh from news is an estimate by stage, shown separately, with its source link. It stays pending review.

panels.title: Energy news
panels.subtitle: Volume and sentiment by topic. Not an article list.
panels.source_note: The news collector tags catalog energy topics. Volume is an article count and sentiment is the mean score. Pending review. Not a production figure.
